# Cupping

Cupping is the standard tasting protocol used to evaluate lots.

## Protocol

1. Grind 8.25 g of coffee per 150 ml of water.
2. Smell the dry grounds.
3. Pour water at 93 °C and wait four minutes.
4. Break the crust and skim.
5. Slurp from a spoon and score.

## Scoring

Scores cover fragrance, flavor, aftertaste, acidity, body and balance. Lots under 84 points are rejected. Results are stored next to the [[roast-log]].
